headline: Inflation concerns remain despite softer April data
caption: With inflation pressures still on the horizon, interest rate decisions could impact mortgage costs soon. As East Auckland buyers and sellers, staying informed about OCR movements helps you time your next property move wisely. We're here to help you navigate what's ahead! 🏡
